items.title: Musk Says Grok Bot “Can Save You Millions in Corporate Expenses.” SpaceX’s Own Accountants Went First
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk is pitching Grok Bot to businesses as a cost-cutter, and SpaceX’s AI unit already has five of the bots in full-time accounting jobs. Selling Grok Bot by the seat would spread SpaceX’s AI revenue, which leans heavily on one cloud customer.

items.title: Workday (WDAY) Expands Payroll Reach, Is The Stock Now Cheap?
items.summary: Workday (WDAY) just rolled out several AI driven payroll tools and new safeguards for its EU Sovereign Cloud, alongside a broader payroll expansion into seven additional countries, giving investors fresh product and geography angles to assess. Despite the busy product calendar, Workday’s share price has been under pressure, with the stock down 15.0% on a 30 day basis and 15.8% year to date, and a 1 year total shareholder return decline of 20.0%. items.summary: Workday (NasdaqGS: WDAY) plans to acquire Honeydew, a semantic layer for AI and business intelligence, to plug into its Workday Data Cloud. The Honeydew deal is intended to support governed business intelligence and autonomous agents across Workday's finance and HR applications. Workday also introduced new operational safeguards for its EU Sovereign Cloud that address European data sovereignty and governance requirements.
